title: Adventure Boat Tours & Watersports
specs: Tours on Lake George, 'The Queen of American Lakes', 32 miles long
Captains provide lake history and are very familiar with the area
Certified service dogs allowed with documentation; no emotional support animals
Boat 1 capacity up to 11 guests; Boat 2 capacity up to 10 guests
Private and group tours available including weddings, corporate events, parties, team building
includes: All safety equipment including life jackets
gap: Exact operating season months not stated
blurb: Guests take 2 to 4-hour boat tours on Lake George, exploring mansions, islands, and bays. Activities include sightseeing, tubing, swimming, cliff jumping (weather and conditions permitting), picnics, and fireworks cruises. Private and group tours are available for events like weddings and corporate parties.
extraNote: Only Adventure Boat Tours can cancel due to bad weather; will offer reschedule or full refund · Guest cancellations 48+ hours in advance refunded minus 10% processing fee; less than 48 hours or no-shows charged full rate · Arrive at least 30 minutes prior; no time extension or partial refunds for late arrival · Boat 1 located at Surfside on the Lake, 400 Canada St., Lake George, NY 12845; Boat 2 is off-site and must be pre-arranged.
